# Italics with terms

> **这页管什么**：只有两种情况用斜体：首次定义术语，和把词当词本身来说。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/italics-terms> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## 1. New terms

Italicize a term the first time it appears, **only when you're defining it immediately**.

- "A _Clos network_ is a kind of multistage circuit switching network."

Don't use bold or quotation marks for this.

## 2. Words referred to as words

Italicize a word, phrase, or letter when discussing the item itself rather than using it for its meaning.

- "Don't use _&_ (ampersand) as a conjunction. Use the word _and_ instead."
- "To form a possessive of a singular noun, add _'s_ to the end of the word."

Don't use bold or quotation marks for this either.
